text:
amanda: heads-up — MedFlow (prod) reporting a spike of 502/504s on streamed generate calls starting ~11:05 PST. They show SDK retry loops and duplicate billing for the window. sample req-id: rqd_20240420_99f2

ben: can you paste the exact request they used and which region? any pattern on payload size or concurrency?

amanda: customer curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xsmall","input":"long prompt...","stream":true}'
```
region: eu-west1. they say streaming fails ~40% of the time, non-streaming works almost always. they run multiplexing in the SDK default mode.

nate: grabbing ingress/edge logs for rqd_20240420_99f2 now. quick theory: ingress recently had a config change reducing max concurrent streams per connection — clients hitting limits may get GOAWAY which some SDKs interpret as fatal and retry whole request. that can explain duplicate billing.

jen: we did roll ingress v3.2 two days ago — lowered max_concurrent_streams from 250 -> 50 to mitigate memory growth. didn't expect streaming-heavy clients to be sensitive.

ops-bot: incident INC-2024-412 created (sev:high)  assigned to eng-runtime, edge-infra, support.

amanda: customer: we can route failover to eu-central1 if it helps. they're amenable to a short change while you investigate.

nate: log snippet for rqd_20240420_99f2: 
```
[2024-04-20T18:07:11Z] rqd_20240420_99f2 http2: sending GOAWAY, last_stream_id=155, error_code=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
[2024-04-20T18:07:11Z] conn 10.2.3.14: downstream conn reset, active_streams=62, max_streams=50
```
This matches the hypothesis. SDK sees a connection-level GOAWAY and retries the streaming request, which results in token-double-charge if the server had already processed tokens.

sam: repro note: ran 60 concurrent streaming connections with multiplexing on and a 8KB initial chunk — hit GOAWAYs within ~90s and observed 502s from the gateway.

jen: mitigation options: 1) revert ingress max_concurrent_streams to previous value (fast) 2) implement server-side per-stream backpressure that refuses new streams instead of GOAWAY (longer) 3) SDK change to avoid full-request retry on GOAWAY for streaming (customer opt-in shorter-term).

amanda: propose short-term: route MedFlow to eu-central1 + ask them to set streaming_multiplex=false in SDK; that should stop the retry loop. we'll revert the ingress change to 250 on a canary for a quick fix.

ops-bot: rolling change 2024-04-20/ingress-maxstreams-revert to canary hosts (3). monitoring: ingress-5xx, http2-goaway-rate, token-duplicate-alerts.

ben: support note for customer comms: explain we saw ingress GOAWAYs due to a config change and that a rollback will be applied. apologise, offer a provisional billing credit for the affected window. what % are we thinking?

billing-bot: recommended credit: 30% for impacted window pending final token-level reconciliation. escalate to billing team to approve.

nate: canary metrics after revert: goaway-rate -> near zero in canary, 5xx rate back to baseline. starting gradual rollout.

ops-bot: rollout 2024-04-20/ingress-maxstreams-revert started to 50% hosts.

amanda: customer updated — they routed to eu-central1 and disabled streaming multiplexing in SDK; errors dropped from ~40% -> <3%. they're okay with a maintenance window to let us finish the rollback.

jen: action items: 1) full rollback to previous max_concurrent_streams (in progress) 2) add a load test for high-concurrency streaming + multiplexing to our CI harness 3) add an SDK guidance note: avoid full-request retry on connection-level GOAWAY for streaming (or provide idempotency hooks) 4) postmortem with eng-runtime + edge infra.

amanda: support will draft customer comms and billing credit draft. will loop back after billing confirms final credit amount.

ben: +1 on postmortem. please include reproducer script and ingress config diffs. thanks everyone.

ops-bot: rollout 2024-04-20/ingress-maxstreams-revert completed to 100% hosts. monitoring window: 30m.

billing-bot: billing team approved provisional 30% credit for MedFlow for timeframe 2024-04-20T11:00-2024-04-20T12:30 UTC. final reconciliation pending token audit.

amanda: closing loop when token audit confirmed. thanks team :thumbsup:
